settings.repere: Titre H2 · How does your 60-day guarantee work?
settings.text: How does your 60-day guarantee work?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Every custom dental appliance is backed
settings.text:
Every custom dental appliance is backed by our 60-Day Smile Guarantee — because your satisfaction is our top priority.

Each appliance is crafted to your unique dental structure with precision and care. While we do everything possible to ensure a perfect fit, everyone's mouth is different. We have a 95% accuracy rate but just like at the dentist, some cases may require a short adjustment period or a minor modification to achieve the most comfortable and natural feel.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · If something doesn't feel quite right, s
settings.text: If something doesn't feel quite right, simply reach out within 60 days of receiving your appliance and we'll adjust or remake it at no cost to you.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · If, after the adjustment, you're still n
settings.text: If, after the adjustment, you're still not fully satisfied, we'll provide a full refund — no questions asked.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Our goal is simple: to make sure you lov
settings.text: Our goal is simple: to make sure you love your new smile and feel confident every time you wear it.
